renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: How do you speak what has no name? If anyone reaches it, it is only by honestly feeling yourself. If a teaching of knowing leaves you with no trust inside, how could it ever give you freedom?

The way is to stay awake in your own waking — that makes the wise one whole. There is no other way but keeping to your own being; keep to it, rest in yourself, and you will be glad. Notice your notions, hold to pure knowing, win the highest joy — and waking grows into one solid mass.

Grip your notions still, and power rests in the powerful; their oneness is the goal. Know your own form, drop the veil, scatter striving — then you are called free. With a fully awake mind hold to waking alone, until by yourself you stand in yourself, alone.
